en:
Hey, Maki. I noticed all those weapons in
your lab, do you know how to use them all?
<CLT=cltMIND>
<CLT=cltMIND>Uh oh. Did I upset her again?
I'm sorry...did I ask something wrong?

...Not really. I just think it's strange that
you keep asking me irrelevant questions.

Depending on the situation, my weapons change.
But I know how to use them all.

Ah, is that right? I imagine stealthy
weapons when I think of assassinations.

We use those too, but I mostly have knives.
Also poison, sniper rifles, jiu-jitsu, bombs—
Bombs? For an assassination?

A warning kill has to be flashy. I've turned
a 5 story building into a 4 story one before.

<CLT=cltMIND>You can control an explosion to
destroy just one floor?

<CLT=cltMIND>How frightening... No wonder she's
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltMIND>...

It's rare to be that flashy though.
Normally, disposing one target is enough.

...So what kind of people
have you assassinated?
What do you mean?

Well, I only know about assassinations
from movies and stuff, so...

...This will probably disappoint you, but
I don't kill only bad people.

I kill anyone on my orders list.
It doesn't matter who the person is.
I suppose that's just the way it is.

...But, I've also had to dispose of 
people who I knew well.
Huh? Like who?
Friends from school.
Friends!? Why would you have to do that?

A daughter of a yakuza leader. She was the
child of a mistress with no ties to the gang.

Her father loved her very much...
Which was why she was seen as dangerous.

The yakuza's elites decided to have her
removed, in case rival groups used her.
What!? But she didn't do anything wrong!
Why!?
I suppose...you had to
Just make sure you don't forget her
Are you unsure of something?
Yeah, but I did as ordered.
Why!?
Why? Because it's my job.
But you were friends, right?

I said it before.
It doesn't matter who they are.
I suppose...you had to.

Yeah. That's when I realized this would
be my life now.
I heard them calling it an act of God...

I don't believe in that.
I also don't intend to blame it on anyone else.
Just make sure you don't forget her.

Why are you looking at me like that? I don't
have time to remember every face I killed.
But...I actually do remember her.
Is this...
...No, it's nothing.

...You may think it's unreasonable to kill
someone on the account of other people.
But...
Everyone does what they can to live.
You, me...and everyone I've murdered.

I kill.
But I can also be killed.
That's all.

<CLT=cltMIND>The cold and indifferent Maki
had been overwhelmed by words...

<CLT=cltMIND>I had never seen that happen before.
I couldn't think of anything to say.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Maki's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Staggering from the weight of Maki's story,
I returned to my room.
